# Blue Collar

> Blue Collar is a workforce management platform for construction and skilled-trade companies (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) in Canada, the United States and Mexico. It provides crew scheduling, GPS-verified clock-in/out that works offline, crew clock-in by a foreman, shift swaps and open shifts, time-off requests, each company's own overtime policy, payroll preparation (gross pay estimates; exports for ADP, Gusto, QuickBooks and Wagepoint), safety forms (incident reports, toolbox talks), and built-in messaging. Available in English, Spanish, French, Punjabi, Hindi and Gujarati. Employer web dashboard plus iPhone and Android employee apps.

Note: llms.txt is an emerging convention; it is provided for AI assistants and is not a ranking guarantee.

- [Privacy](https://bluecollarshift.com/privacy): privacy policy
- [Contact](https://bluecollarshift.com/contact): sales, support and security contacts

## Facts
- Payroll output is a gross-pay estimate; Blue Collar does not calculate statutory deductions or remit payroll.
- Location is captured only at clock events; no continuous tracking.
